blocks.text: How did we build a story from fragmented archival records?
Story-building examines how historical fragments are transformed into narratives.

"We wanted to sonify the Huize Dina archive and present it in the form of an artistic podcast; we envisioned it taking place in a virtual auditory space; we strove to tell the girls' stories (though their actual voices were absent from the files, and many details about them were missing), and we restricted ourselves to a single kind of material — the documents found in the archive. As it turned out, these very constraints led us to a breakthrough." — Amit
